name: PST
summary: Poppy tea can be made from poppy pods, stalks, and seeds. It contains various opium alkaloids primarily including morphine, as well as codeine and among others. There is great variation in poppy tea potency and therefore doses are indicated for opioid naive users. There are many reports of overdoses due to inconsistent, unpredicable, dosing.

pharmacology.en: Its main active compounds, morphine and codeine, activate mu-opioid receptors, which relieves pain and causes euphoria and sedation but also slows breathing. Other poppy alkaloids such as thebaine and noscapine are also present.
pharmacology.zh: 它的主要活性成分嗎啡和可待因會活化 μ 鴉片受體，帶來止痛、欣快和鎮靜作用，但也會抑制呼吸。茶中也含有蒂巴因和那可汀等其他罌粟生物鹼。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的主要活性成分吗啡和可待因会活化 μ 鸦片受体，带来止痛、欣快和镇静作用，但也会抑制呼吸。茶中也含有蒂巴因和那可汀等其他罂粟生物碱。

uses.en: It is drunk as a traditional remedy in some regions, and is used recreationally and by some people to self-treat pain or opioid withdrawal.
uses.zh: 在部分地區它被當作傳統偏方飲用，也有人把它當作娛樂用途，或用來自行處理疼痛或鴉片戒斷。
uses.zhHans: 在部分地区它被当作传统偏方饮用，也有人把它当作娱乐用途，或用来自行处理疼痛或鸦片戒断。

sideEffects.en: The strength of poppy tea varies enormously from batch to batch, and there have been many fatal overdoses, in which breathing slows or stops. Other effects include nausea, constipation, itching and drowsiness. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 罌粟茶的濃度每批差異極大，已有許多致命的過量案例，原因是呼吸變慢或停止。其他效應包括噁心、便秘、搔癢和嗜睡。規律使用會導致依賴和戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 罂粟茶的浓度每批差异极大，已有许多致命的过量案例，原因是呼吸变慢或停止。其他效应包括恶心、便秘、搔痒和嗜睡。规律使用会导致依赖和戒断症状。

fact.en: Poppy tea is made from the opium poppy, Papaver somniferum. The species name somniferum is Latin for sleep-bringing.
fact.zh: 罌粟茶是用罌粟（Papaver somniferum）製成的。種名 somniferum 在拉丁文中意思是「帶來睡眠的」。
fact.zhHans: 罂粟茶是用罂粟（Papaver somniferum）制成的。种名 somniferum 在拉丁文中意思是「带来睡眠的」。
